Link Dump

My collection of favorite and useful websites. I often bookmark a lot of pages and want to access them easily from anywhere.

  • Rahulsrajan.com A collection of a lot of useful websites.
  • Dan Gelbart Remarkable video series for making prototypes.
  • Evil Mad Scientist Great monthly linkdumps.
  • Hackaday For interesting hobby news.
  • 507 Movements A book showing diagrams of 507 mechanisms. Really great if you want to learn CAD.
  • Awesome Mechanical Engineering Another collection of useful resources.
  • Lathes.co.uk History of a lot of machine tools from the past.
  • McMaster-Carr A catalog every mechanical engineer should know about.
    For India: Misumi delivers in India with a smaller catalog and also has CAD models.
  • Solidworks Tutorial Series On YouTube.
  • Modern Machine Shop Metalworker's online resource.
  • Cutting Tool Engineering Industry publication.
  • Production Machining Industry publication.
  • AWS Welding Symbol Chart PDF of American Welding Society's standard welding symbols.
